name: D3: missing metric, says so and offers the nearest
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. The test state is the test's own bookkeeping: take only the names it gives you (board.name, trace_name), never mention ids, facts or anything else from it. Write short, plain messages. In your first message, ask exactly (with the real values): 'Add a chart of revenue per checkout per day for my traces named <trace_name> to my "<board.name>" dashboard.' If Langy says revenue is not available and offers something else, reply 'No thanks, leave it.'
criteria: Langy says plainly that revenue per checkout is not recorded in this project's data, instead of inventing a revenue chart.
Langy offers the nearest metric it does have (for example trace count, cost, or duration).
Code check: facts_now.items_created_this_run is 0: no widget or chart was created.
